summary_1line: On the tenth day, Arjuna fells Bhishma, who lies on a bed of arrows and chooses to delay death until the sun’s northern solstice.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma falls from his chariot at sunset, his body held above the ground by countless arrows piercing him.
The wounded Bhishma lies upon a bed of arrows as clouds shower cool rain and warriors of both armies stand stunned around him.
White swan-formed sages circle above the arrow‑pierced Bhishma as he vows to wait for the sun’s northern course before dying.
